crossRefs.note: House of Israel, praise Yahweh! House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!
Yahweh will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise Yah!
Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion; for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”
How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news, who…
“Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in Yahweh, your God; for he gives you the early rain in just measure…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Praise Yahweh, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!
translations.bsb: Exalt the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion!
translations.kjv: Praise the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.
translations.asv: Praise Jehovah, O Jerusalem; Praise thy God, O Zion.
